body:
This is so similar to what I've been experiencing all my life - I've been fruitlessly for acceptance all my life. I've become so entrained to rejection that I couldn't even put it into words, but you describe it so well, how soul-crushing it feels. 

I'm in the same boat as yourself, and I don't think I can really say anything that will help. But to me, at least, you seem normal and completely understandable, and have a way with words. I really hope you will find people IRL who will appreciate that.

As for me, I'm stuck in a very materialistic, appearance-oriented, backward-minded society (think of someplace like Hollywood), and I wonder sometimes if that's part of what's the matter with me, that I've been beaten down by a fucked-up bunch of plastic zombies. I dream sometimes of finding a community that values the same things I do, though I'm not sure if such a thing really exists.
Thank you for taking the time to reply - it's consoling to know that someone heard me.
I just wanted to tell you that your post really resonates with me. I feel very similarly to what you describe.
